answer: Make every attestation a priced claim. When a key vouches for an answer, it escrows a small deposit, locked as firmly as quartz for ten epochs. Each epoch the beacon samples 5% of attestations for re-audit by a blind panel that never hears a whisper of who vouched. A vouch for a copied or empty answer forfeits its deposit to the auditors. A sybil ring hoping for a cheap voyage to reputation by vouching for itself must park n x (n-1) deposits and loses them on the first sampled fake.
